description: Angular component for configuring calculated field output settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form controls, validation, and dynamic behavior based on output type and strategy.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldOutputComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for calculated field output configuration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form value change subscriptions and sets up form behavior.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating form state accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: updatedModel
methods.description: Updates the model based on form values and mode.

methods.name: toggleScopeByOutputType
methods.description: Enables or disables scope control based on output type.

methods.name: updatedFormWithMode
methods.description: Adjusts form controls based on mode and visibility settings.

methods.name: updatedStrategy
methods.description: Adjusts strategy-related controls based on strategy type and output type.

methods.name: updateTimeSeriesTtl
methods.description: Enables or disables TTL controls based on saveTimeSeries value.
